correctness.rationale: Read complete source verify.py and reconstructed its finite exact certificate independently. All independent faces of C5□C5 were enumerated from neighbor masks, giving exactly 25,531 augmented faces and f-vector (1,25,250,1300,3850,6745,7100,4450,1550,250,10) in dimensions -1..9. Greedy pivot matching over all 25 vertices pairs exactly 12,761 disjoint lower-upper faces, including (empty,{0}), leaving nine size-five masks [1196104,1313284,2360464,2625576,4235344,4720898,8425986,8470786,16850980]. Independently constructed the complete oriented Hasse cover digraph and topologically sorted all 25,531 nodes, proving it acyclic (not a sample). Deleting the empty-face pair leaves one critical 0-cell and nine critical 4-cells with no intermediate cells; Forman matching gives wedge^9 S^4. Integer torsion-freeness follows from the explicit homotopy wedge, not solely Euler/field homology.
residual_risks: Finite result for one 5x5 periodic graph only.
The full finite check was completed independently, but this is computationally certified, not an independently constructed symbolic infinite classification.

originality.rationale: Jonsson 2006 analyzes signed Euler characteristics of the exact doubly periodic grid and rhombus tilings, which do not determine integral homotopy. Bousquet-Mélou–Linusson–Nevo give open/cylindrical grid homotopy types, geometrically distinct from full toroidal periodicity. A 2010 Jonsson specialist article treats periodic cross-polytope cycles; only abstract was accessible after lawful OA search and institutional Oxford reported VPN disconnected, so it remains a material historical risk. A related published 4x4 torus is not this 5x5 calculation. Best-of-knowledge O PASS acknowledges no whole-document noncoverage of Jonsson 2010.
residual_risks: Jonsson 2010 specialist primary full text was inaccessible (authorized institutional VPN disconnected), so an equivalent result in its uninspected portion cannot be excluded.
Finite single-instance classification is intrinsically narrower than a uniform periodic-grid homotopy theorem; exact natural small instance is still independently useful.

value.rationale: The 25-vertex 5x5 toroidal hard-square complex is a canonical small non-bipartite fully periodic grid where signed partition functions are known but integral homotopy can carry attaching/torsion information that Euler counts miss. The complete explicit discrete-Morse certificate gives its full homotopy type (nine 4-spheres), not a mere recomputation of a known table. This exact natural finite benchmark is useful in periodic lattice topology despite no general m,n theorem.
residual_risks: Result applies to a single small torus only, and the inaccessible Jonsson 2010 text could affect originality.

final_claim: The independence complex of the square toroidal grid C_5□C_5 is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of nine 4-spheres, so H̃_4=Z^9 and all other reduced integral homology vanishes, with no torsion.
limitations: No all-size periodic-grid conjecture is established by the one-instance matching.
